description: Atomic mass and Q-value tables by Hecke level k=3,4,5 with explicit error bounds. Each nucleus shows B(k=3), B(k=4), B(k=5) vs AME2020, with truncation, parametric (δq), and CODATA input uncertainties. Q-values computed by both NF trace ratio and BW difference methods.

unified_path.description: Unified iterative (2,2) Wedderburn projection accumulator — replaces dedicated D-binding (A=2), knot factor (A=3,4), and Wigner energy (k≥5) terms by ONE mechanism (prop:unified-iterative-correction).  Per-step: ΔB_k = DELTA_22 × w_(2,2) × (ln|Tr M_22^(0..k)| − ln|Tr M_22^(0..k-1)|), telescopes to B_unified = DELTA_22 × w_(2,2) × ln|Tr M_22^(0..A)/2|.
unified_path.energy_scale_derivation: DELTA_22 = m_e × H_q((2,2)) = m_e × [3]·[2]² (q-hook product) — equals empirical Wigner scale Δ_W ≈ 6.3 MeV [satula1997] without fitting.

error_budget.parametric: δq propagation through q-integer BW coefficients
error_budget.truncation: |B(k) - B(k-1)|: magnitude of last included correction
